changes.title: Telescope sliders
items: Test sliders on the pause page for the telescope: its haze (near and far) and its vignette, to try more colour in its view

changes.title: Legend circles
items: Legend circles are sized to their sleeping legend, so big legends (lions, tigers, elk, griffins) no longer spill over the ring
A legend's circle is ringed by trees and stones all the way round: you find it by walking in, not by seeing it from outside

changes.title: Area blend
items: Neighbouring areas blend more gradually: their trees and bushes mix across a wider, wandering band
